entry.title: FuTURE at IROS 2026!
entry.content:
FuTURE Lab had a great time at the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026 in Pittsburgh! PhD student Aabha Tamhankar presented our latest work on contact-aware path planning for autonomous neuroendovascular navigation, and our PI Giovanni Pittiglio joined the panel “New Experiences in Clinical Collaborations: Junior Faculty in Medical Robotics” at the Training the Future Medical Roboticist workshop.

Check out our work:

Title: Contact-Aware Path Planning for Autonomous Neuroendovascular Navigation
Authors: Aabha Tamhankar, Ron Alterovitz, Ajit S. Puri, Giovanni Pittiglio
Link: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/stamp/stamp.jsp?arnumber=11373832

entry.title: FuTURE at ISMR 2026!
entry.content:
FuTURE Lab presented two papers at the International Symposium on Medical Robotics (ISMR) 2026! Our PI Giovanni Pittiglio, PhD student Aabha Tamhankar, and undergraduate researcher Alex Sayres shared our latest work on autonomous robots for stroke care and on the design of magnetic continuum robots.

Check out our work:

Title: An Anatomy-specific Guidewire Shaping Robot for Improved Vascular Navigation
Authors: Aabha Tamhankar, Jay Patil, Giovanni Pittiglio
Link: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/stamp/stamp.jsp?arnumber=11536408

Title: Design of Magnetic Continuum Robots with Tunable Force Response Using Rotational Ring Pairs
Authors: Alex Sayres, Giovanni Pittiglio
Link: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/stamp/stamp.jsp?arnumber=11536338

entry.title: Paper Accepted in RA-L!
entry.content:
Excited to share our collaborative research with Ron Alterovitz and Ajit Puri has been accepted for publication in the IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L) journal!

Title: Contact-aware Path Planning for Autonomous Neuroendovascular Navigation

Authors: Aabha Tamhankar, Ron Alterovitz, Ajit S. Puri, Giovanni Pittiglio

Link: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/stamp/stamp.jsp?arnumber=11373832

We propose a deterministic, contact-aware path planner for neurovascular navigation that leverages kinematic model to predict and exploit anatomical interactions for fast and accurate control of pre-bent passive tools.

Attached is a video demonstrating results of our planner using a guidewire-catheter system to autonomously navigate into three common aortic arch types, targeting two different branches in each scenario.

entry.title: FuTURE Wins Award at ISMR 2025!
entry.content:
We are proud to announce that FuTURE Lab’s paper, “Towards Autonomous Navigation of Neuroendovascular Tools for Timely Stroke Treatment via Contact-aware Path Planning,” was awarded 2nd Place for Best Student Paper at the International Symposium on Medical Robotics (ISMR) 2025, held this month at Georgia Tech!

Authors: Aabha Tamhankar, Giovanni Pittiglio

Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.15971
